summary: Live Oak Bancshares filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of 4,000,000 depositary shares, each representing a 1/40th interest in a share of 8.750% Fixed Rate Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series B, with a $25 per depositary share liquidation preference ($1,000 per underlying share). Dividends are non-cumulative and payable quarterly beginning December 15, 2026. Redemption is optional on or after December 15, 2031, or within 90 days of a regulatory capital treatment event. Application was made to list on NYSE under LOB PRB. The capital raise strengthens regulatory capital; watch pricing and preferred overhang.
